caption: The drawing features a circular, decorative object at its center, containing a scene with two human figures set against an outdoor background. Inside the circle, there is a woman dressed in a long, flowing pink dress with white sleeves and a headdress, and a man in a green outfit with yellow accents, kneeling on one knee before her. The woman has one hand raised to her chest while the other hand appears extended toward the man. Behind them are greenish-brown bushes and a columned stone structure with a base, situated on a stone floor or terrace. The outer rim of the circular frame is golden brown with decorative detailing. In the top right corner of the page, there is a technical drawing in gray ink, depicting the same circular object from a top and side view, with the top view showing a plain circle and the side view showing a short pedestal beneath, along with measurement marks. The background of the overall page is light beige.
title: Powder Box
